correctness.rationale: For positive peripheral counts and hub present, each coordinate increases/decreases with probability x_i/(2s). The product h=∏x_i is bounded harmonic, with zero on any missing leaf. Its Doob transform has probabilities (x_i±1)/(2s), a total-count Markov chain independent of composition, and conditional Polya-urn addition/uniform-deletion transitions yielding the Dirichlet-multinomial law with parameters two. At total n the exact law is c∏l_i, which divided by h(l) gives the uniform c; sum over positive compositions gives the joint probability, and fixed-d factorial asymptotics and a lattice Riemann sum give the Dirichlet limit. The checker independently solves original-chain rational systems for all 114 terminals across 13 cases. No finite-check-to-infinite inference.

originality.rationale: Berenbrink et al. (2026) prove individual survival bounds, simultaneous-survival count concentration, and a one-dimensional gambler-ruin star example, but not the full joint all-survivor terminal support distribution. Öztürk (2011 preprint) studies bounded-confidence three-opinion absorption via master equations and finite probability calculations, without the arbitrary-degree uniform-composition formula. Hardin and Lanchier (2019) provide confidence-model consensus bounds. Real claim- and alias-targeted searches of published mathematical research results returned no matching terminal-vector law; related urn and multitype extinction theorems remain a realistic prior-coverage risk. This is not a claim of exhaustive uniqueness.
residual_risks: Unindexed or differently named multitype neutral branching-process exit distributions may imply the identity without matching voter-model terms.
Earlier three-opinion transition-matrix literature may contain a particular d=2 formula; the general arbitrary-star-degree result is the assessed claim.
Finite numerical checks alone do not establish the general statement; the analytical Doob-transform argument is necessary.
No independent scientific review has been performed.

value.rationale: A natural unresolved distinction in bounded-confidence opinion dynamics is between lower bounds on marginal survival/number of surviving opinions and exact co-survival probabilities. The theorem computes the full absorbing distribution of a rare social-opinion coexistence event, including factorial probability scaling and a nondegenerate conditional Dirichlet law. This makes an otherwise unquantified structural feature precise for all star degrees.
